text:
Rita Gomez: Quick haul from last week's onboarding + renewal check-ins (25 clips, 6 support threads). Need a tight feed for PMs: atomic asks, indicate if it's product/enablement/infra, severity, and whether it should escalate for renewal risk. Can someone take the first pass today?

Caleb Stone: I can do it. Plan: ASR -> snippet extraction -> label (product/infra/enablement) -> one-line 'ask' + evidence. Will mark 'renewal_risk' when customer mentions pause/discount/renewal call.

Aisha Khan: For prioritization, let's do a simple triage: severity (low/med/high) + customer value (small/medium/large) -> priority tags urgent/important/monitor. Add 'pattern_id' if we see the same ask across accounts.

Rita Gomez: Also separate 'enablement' asks (docs/train) so PM backlog isn't clogged. If an ask is both product and enablement, mark crosslink.

product-bot: Uploaded file cs_voice_batch_1786543210.tar.gz -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/batches/cs_voice_batch_1786543210.tar.gz :file_folder:

Caleb Stone: Sample CSV header I'll use:
customer,source,id,ask,category,severity,customer_value,renewal_risk,pattern_id,evidence,notes

Caleb Stone: First-pass samples:
NimbusHealth,call,n_h_05,"Need per-route cost toggle in console","billing","high","large",true,billing-route-01,"'we can't see cost per integration' - renewal call","audio clear"
ParcelCo,support,pc-311,"Clarify token billing for batch embeddings","billing","med","medium",false,billing-clarity-02,"asked in onboarding workshop","enablement suggested"
Veridian,call,vd_09,"Require private model pinning for compliance","infra","high","large",true,infra-pinning-03,"security lead insisted","escalate to infra"

Aisha Khan: Nice. For duplicates, create a canonical 'pattern' card with links to all evidence clips. PMs can triage patterns instead of single mentions.

Caleb Stone: I propose automation rules to prototype: if severity==high OR renewal_risk==true -> auto-create 'customer-voice' ticket with transcript excerpt and cc CSM. If category==enablement && severity!=high -> create docs task.

Rita Gomez: Good. Also add a quick 'estimated_effort' tag (S/M/L) so PMs can quickly see cheap wins. For example copy changes or docs are S.

product-bot: Generated extract cs_voice_extract_1786543210.csv -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/exports/cs_voice_extract_1786543210.csv :file_folder:

Aisha Khan: I'll run a quick dedupe pass and assign pattern_ids. Caleb can then push top-10 priority items to the PM triage board. I'll flag anything with renewal_risk=true for immediate review.

Caleb Stone: Two small notes: 1) Found 3 low-audio clips flagged as 'needs-listen' in notes. 2) One recurring UX ask about "ambiguous quota messages" across 4 accounts -> pattern billing-ambig-07, estimated_effort=S. Recommend quick copy update and a short enablement note.

Rita Gomez: Perfect. Ownership: Caleb does extraction + creates initial tickets; Aisha dedupes and assigns pattern_ids; I'll prepare the short brief for PMs and CSM leads. Escalate any P0 signals to CS leadership.

product-bot: Reminder: CS->Product sync in 1h. Agenda auto-added: "Voice ingest 1786543210: top patterns and renewal flags".

Aisha Khan: I'll finish dedupe in next 30m and share the CSV link. If legal/privacy is needed for quoting customers, tag 'needs-legal' in notes.

Caleb Stone: CSV live in Drive now. Pinging PMs and CS leads.

Rita Gomez: Thanks team — see you in the sync. :thumbsup:
